records.subject: Eu content x increases from 0.10 to 0.15 in polycrystalline bulk (Sr1−xEux)3Ti2O7
records.conditions: 300–1000 K; continuation of the experimental composition comparison
records.quote: The transport and thermoelectric properties of polycrystalline bulk samples (Sr1-xEux)(3)Ti2O7 with different Eu-doped contents x were investigated.
context_quotes: The experiments revealed that electrical resistivity rho and the absolute value of Seebeck coefficient |S| decreased as x increased from 0.05 to 0.1 at temperatures ranging from 300 to 1000 K.

However, electrical resistivity rho increased instead when x further increased from 0.1 to 0.15, whereas |S| dropped below 450 K and then rose above 450 K. |S| for (Sr1-xEux)(3)Ti2O7 (x = 0.05, 0.1) increased linearly in tandem with an increase in temperature, whereas |S| for (Sr1-xEux)(3)Ti2O7 (x = 0.15) increased first, decreased next, and finally increased in tandem with an increase in temperature.
modality_evidence: The experiments revealed that electrical resistivity rho and the absolute value of Seebeck coefficient |S| decreased as x increased from 0.05 to 0.1 at temperatures ranging from 300 to 1000 K.

records.subject: Maximum magnetic entropy change
records.quote: The thermal response of a magnetic solid to an applied magnetic field constitutes magnetocaloric effect.
context_quotes: The maximum magnetic entropy change (MMEC) is one of the quantitative parameters characterizing this effect, while the magnetic solids exhibiting magnetocaloric effect have great potential in magnetic refrigeration technology as they offer a green solution to the known pollutant-based refrigerants.
